_meta: Per-char advance widths (em @100px) + fontBoundingBox ascent/descent of the faces in the kit's Vietnamese fonts.css (engine/vendor/hf-captions-vi, made by engine/tests/hf_captions_vi.py): HF's table measured again the same way, with the Vietnamese letters added. Measured per-char advance widths (em @100px) + fontBoundingBox ascent/descent for the bundled families in modes/standard/fonts/fonts.css. Generated once via headless-Chrome canvas measureText over the SAME woff2 faces the renderer embeds (kerning ignored, ~<=3px/word). Used by make-theme.cjs to BAKE pixel-exact word geometry at compile time so font-load timing in the render browser can never skew aim. Regenerate if fonts.css changes.
